meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 在 shadcn/ui 项目中，Claude 会负责添加、搜索、修复、调试、样式化与组合组件（含聊天界面）。它会先读取项目配置与已装组件，再用 CLI 安装/更新，并按内置规则检查样式、表单与结构，产出符合规范的代码。
howto.when: 当你处理 shadcn/ui、组件注册表或预设（--preset 代码）等项目时触发；说“shadcn init”、要求用 --preset 建应用或切换预设时也会触发。

say.text: 给这个项目添加一个 dialog 组件
say.note: Claude 会先查看项目配置，再运行 add 安装并检查。

say.text: 搜索一下有没有表单类组件可以用
say.note: Claude 会运行 search 并给出可安装的组件列表。

say.text: 把这个页面的 space-y-4 改成 flex gap-4
say.note: Claude 会按样式规则修正并复核。

howto.what_en: In a shadcn/ui project, Claude adds, searches, fixes, debugs, styles, and composes components (including chat UI). It reads the project config and installed components, installs/updates via the CLI, then checks rules before producing compliant code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with shadcn/ui, component registries, or presets (--preset codes), and when you say 'shadcn init', create an app with --preset, or switch presets.

say_en.text: Add a dialog component to this project
say_en.note: It reads the config, runs add, and reviews the code.

say_en.text: Search for a form component we can use
say_en.note: It runs search and lists installable components.

say_en.text: Change space-y-4 to flex gap-4 on this page
say_en.note: It applies the style rule and re-checks.
